summary: Security recheck after fix cycle 3: self-resume now keeps the PR a Draft; three medium gaps for R2 leaves #153/#154 accepted provisionally. Approved.
basis: Reviewed the whole change against d215a63 with docs/policies/security.md (no project overlay exists) and the R2 boundaries. No tools/, .agents/ or .github/ file changed. Fix cycle 3 makes a self-resume count as a resolved block for ADR-0019 condition (11), so an unattended resume can no longer be marked ready; the runner event stays non-human, keeping BL-INV-006. Pre-merge authority and runner invariants still block; trust in authors comes only from operator data. Three medium statements remain unstated (resume trigger source, limit-time publication guards, high findings pushed as Draft). No cycle remains, each belongs to an R2 leaf with its own security review, and nothing acts before merge.

findings.label: architecture-issue
findings.reason: Unchanged: Self-resume does not say the resume is armed only by the operator's own invocation through the trusted launcher, or that a usage limit is recognized from data the confined agent cannot write. ADR-0010's lock, sync and re-entry still bind it; #154 is R2 with its own security review and no code here acts before merge.

findings.label: architecture-issue
findings.reason: Unchanged: Limit outcome publishes in any phase without saying the pre-publication guards (protected-input/tamper verification, record re-render, ADR-0016 privileged actions) still apply. The stop rule's tamper block partly covers it; #153 is R2 and implements it, and the Delivery bullet keeps today's blocks until then.

findings.label: spec-ambiguity
findings.reason: Unchanged: a trusted author's Issue body can later be edited by collaborators with triage or write access; the ready-for-agent label has the same exposure, so no new risk. #152 may pin trust to the Issue state at intake.

findings.label: architecture-issue
findings.reason: Unchanged: a high finding left after the fix cycles or at plan review/reconciliation goes to the limit outcome, so its branch is pushed and can run CI where today it blocks. ADR-0019 conditions (7) and (9) keep such a PR a Draft; documentation-only here and #153 is R2.

findings.label: architecture-issue
findings.reason: Fix cycle 3 states that a self-resume counts as a block resolved during the run for ADR-0019 condition (11), so an unattended resume keeps the PR a Draft; test_self_resume checks it.
